Android devices with a Qualcomm Adreno GPU: the new renderer now starts instead of showing a graphics warning. Found on Meta Quest 3, but the fix applies to every Adreno phone, tablet and headset.
The Android and Quest app now has its icon.
Fixed a crash on the first loading screen on Meta Quest 3.
Doors and other loose props now get the same light as in the original game: they no longer look pale and flat indoors, and they pick up sunlight outdoors.
Arched wooden doors in the Mountain City indoor areas are no longer pale gray; they are dark brown again.
Light shafts in doorways and windows now fade softly at their edges like the original game, instead of showing as a hazy glass-like panel.
Helicopter rotor discs no longer show dark streaks leaking out of their square corners.
Fixed a milky haze over nearby dark buildings and walls when looking toward the sun.
Posters that were already highlighted when the level loaded now still light correctly in the new renderer.
Shared highlighted materials (such as posters that share one picture) now light together in the new renderer, matching the original.
